your_tasks.title: Pick the right GCD series for the ones it couldn't match
your_tasks.why: GCD (the Grand Comics Database) fills details for series Metron doesn't have. When several GCD series share a name (Tintin has 145), kometa won't guess.
your_tasks.how: I'll list each one with its candidates when the first batch is done (about 7 hours for all ~130 series). You pick one per series, or 'none of these'.

your_tasks.title: Say go for copying covers into your library folders (step 2)
your_tasks.why: Covers become part of the library: a hidden .kometa/covers/ folder in each series folder on the NAS, so the nightly comics backup protects them and the store on ginbako can later move to Catbus. Dry run done (read-only): 685 series folders, 18,154 files, 3.84 GB today (it grows as the harvest adds full-size covers). Each file is written to a temp name, size-checked, then renamed; re-running only writes what's new. 375 covers belong to series you track but don't own (no folder) — those stay in the local store.
your_tasks.how: Reply 'go covers'. It takes ~10–15 minutes over the network, pausing while you read.

your_tasks.title: Say go for moving kometa's cover store to Catbus
your_tasks.why: Frees ~4–9 GB on ginbako. Same kind of move as this morning's caches, same guard if Catbus isn't mounted.
your_tasks.how: A yes. About a minute of downtime.

your_tasks.title: Say go for the 16-file test batch, then check them (step 3e)
your_tasks.why: The rewrite job is built and a dry run passed on 16 deliberately varied files (modern Marvel, 1963 scans, a #605.1, Fables' 2022 run, two CBRs, Tintin, a 300 MB file…). Writing them proves the real swap end to end before the full run. Each original is read back before the swap; CBRs' old files go to _trash; Voot II keeps the originals 30 days. Many of these still carry stand-in data (Metron hasn't reached them) — the test is about the files, not the data; they'll be retagged later with the better record.
your_tasks.how: Reply 'go test batch'. I'll list the 16 files; open a few in kometa (and Panels/YondeB if you like): pages intact, reading progress kept, details showing.

your_tasks.title: Say go for the full ComicInfo rewrite (step 3f)
your_tasks.why: Every file gets its clean ComicInfo. ~10 hours of network time; pauses while you read; Voot II keeps every original for 30 days.
your_tasks.how: A yes, after the test batch.

your_tasks.title: OK deleting the Komga container and its config
your_tasks.why: Komga is stopped and nothing uses it. Its config is also in the Voot II backup.
your_tasks.how: A yes, any time after a few days with no problems.

your_tasks.title: OK deleting today's 4 safety copies of the database
